Our team designed a laccase construct and cloned it into an expression vector.

We expressed BBa_K123456 in E. coli BL21(DE3). The culture was grown in LB and induced with 0.5 mM IPTG at 37°C for 4 hours. Unfortunately expression failed and the protein accumulated as inclusion bodies.

The soluble fraction was checked by SDS-PAGE. The gel showed no band at the expected 35 kDa.

Sponsors provided polymerase, buffer, and lab coats for the team this season.

In a later design we chose a fusion tag to avoid inclusion bodies.

Baneyx F. Recombinant protein folding and inclusion bodies. Nature Biotechnology.

Wells 3 and 7 show no band at 800 bp, therefore the removal of the Gm cassette has been successful.

The promoter control was tested in astrocytes and the promoter is not expressed in that cell line.

The Western blot was negative for the secreted fraction of BBa_K999999 produced in E. coli DH5α.

We FAILED TO EXPRESS the reporter from BBa_K555555 in shake flasks.
